ways.label: Motukarara to Little River
evidence: Beginning at the restored Motukarara Railway Station, the trail follows the line of the old railway through open paddocks.
After this there's a short on road section just before Little River.
The township of Little River offers a craft and information centre, pub, cafe, gallery and accommodation.

ways.label: Christchurch (Hornby) to Motukarara section
evidence: This 26 km section is not maintained by DOC.
The Hornby (Christchurch) to Prebbleton section (3.5k m) is an off-road track that runs alongside Shands Rd and Marshes Rd.
Neills Rd to Motukarara (6 km) is an off-road track that mostly runs adjacent to the Halswell Canal.

doubts: DOC's '20 km one way' fits the Motukarara to Little River section the page describes as its walk; the Christchurch to Motukarara section (26 km, not maintained by DOC) is recorded as a second way since the page title covers Christchurch, but it may be better seen as an extension. The start is the Motukarara Railway Station at the Fiddlers Road entrance; no feature names Fiddlers Road, so I used the place Motukarara (T7) rather than the Park Road road ends (F7/F8). End F9 is where the rail trail meets Christchurch Akaroa Road at Little River (same point as the place Little River); the text mentions a short on-road section just before Little River, so the exact trail end is not certain. The text does not say whether the trail returns the same way. Access points are from a list of toilets and parking after 'There are a number of entry points onto the rail trail'; Cantons Bay is probably the Catons Bay picnic spot on the way. The Birdlings Flat detour's leaving point is not stated.
